positions.name: SettledDecisionRatification
positions.frame: does the expression perform or record the settling of a course of action, rather than argue for it?
positions.why: src-1's 'We are adopting' and src-3's committed timeline perform a decision in prose; src-4 and src-6 restate the same adoption and timeline as flat labelled-field entries in the summary block. Both registers (conversational declarative and bold-label catalogue) enact the same settled course rather than argue for it — the conviction reads align as 'decision' across all four, so the group holds despite the register shift between prose and summary.

positions.name: PerformanceCapabilityClaim
positions.frame: is the performance figure presented as an unratified factual claim standing behind the decision, or as part of the settled record itself?
positions.why: src-2's prose assertion and src-5's bold-label restatement both state the '15x' comparison as a claim ready to be defended rather than a ratified decision — conviction reads both as 'claim' rather than 'decision', distinguishing this pair from the adoption/timeline group even though src-5 shares src-4/src-6's summary-block register.
